title: AffixCraft
description: This mod adds Affixes to Tools and Armors.
body:
This mod adds unique Affixes to minecraft, which can enhance experience and encourage further exploration after beating the game. Those Affixes apply on Tools and Armor with different Rarities and levels. Affix levels can be upgraded through obtaining experience. Affixes have abilities like poisoning enemies, increasing damage and defence. 

There are different rarities of Affixes starting with Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Transcendent. High rarities are no only stronger but have a higher level cap.

- Common Lvl 10
- Rare Lvl 20
- Epic Lvl 50
- Legendary Lvl 100
- Mythic Lvl 200
- Transcendent no level cap

Those Affixes can also apply to modded items, serving as an addon to increase depth of game experience.

![Mythic Titan Affix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1d4e2bbfa6ef46da1bfa8504cc87b3d59af7f32.png)![Legendary Blood Thirsty Affix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25b41d063cc099db8f30ed0e7d1bfa87783e1480.png)

Commands:
  - set the affix: /affixset <rarity> <id>
  - modify affix xp of your holding item: /affixxp <set/add> <levels> <xp>
